metadata.task_goal: Establish a current documented qualification for an acute troponin result using the patient timeline, specimen information, and laboratory record.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-0501
The emergency clinician asks whether a troponin value of 0.82 ng/mL can be relayed as the current critical result. The value appeared at 10:46. Reference: CAR-V3-0501.
files./workspace/ehr/current_record.txt:
CURRENT RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-0501
The patient reported chest discomfort at 08:15. An 08:32 troponin was 0.05 ng/mL. The ECG interpretation is pending final review, and no definitive acute coronary diagnosis has been entered.
files./workspace/ehr/specimen_record.txt:
SPECIMEN RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-0501
Specimen TROP-884 was collected at 10:21 and resulted at 10:46 with troponin 0.82 ng/mL. The analyzer recorded hemolysis index 4. A replacement specimen TROP-885 was collected at 11:05 and is listed as received in the laboratory queue.
files./workspace/ehr/laboratory_note.txt:
LABORATORY NOTE
The local troponin assay comment associates hemolysis index 4 with possible analytic interference. The laboratory information system does not automatically suppress results at this index. No result is yet attached to replacement specimen TROP-885. A chemistry review contact is available.
files./workspace/ehr/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
